dedupe_keys.name: atm gen a synthetic air traffic management data generator

description: ATM-GEN: a synthetic Air Traffic Management data generator is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Bashar Ahmad, Christoph G. Schuetz (Institute of Business Informatics - Data & Knowledge Engineering, Johannes Kepler University Linz, Austria). ATM-GEN produces standards-compliant Air Traffic Management datasets over a coherent, fictitious airspace. From a compact airspace model derived from the Donlon 2022 reference dataset, it generates aeronautical infrastructure baselines (AIXM 5.1.1), notices to airmen, meteorological reports (IWXXM 3.0 METAR, TAF, and SIGMET), and flight objects (FIXM 4.3) for any requested date range. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
